name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: A blur that ramps from 0 to 20px over 80px toward an edge, from stacked masked backdrop layers, for headers, bottom bars and composers. Optionally scroll-linked so it appears only once content is underneath.
docs: Import ProgressiveBlur from components/eased/progressive-blur/progressive-blur. Place it over the scroller in a positioned parent, never inside it, and keep opacity, filter and mask off its ancestors.
